svg.aria-label: A graph and a labelled dataset of 8 cases, 6 for development and 2 held out. sapho record runs once per case against Jev and the 8 answers are saved in one recording. Tune and measure then run offline: tuning on development cases scores the 0.7 / 0.8 rule 1.00 and the 0.9 / 0.9 rule 0.67. The chosen rule is measured once on held-out cases, and development cases can be exported for a trainer outside Sapho.
